generationContext.text:
# Microsoft Azure Private Dns management client library for .NET

Microsoft Azure Private DNS provides a reliable and secure DNS service for your virtual network. Azure Private DNS manages and resolves domain names in the virtual network without the need to configure a custom DNS solution.

This library supports managing Microsoft Azure Private Dns resources.

This library follows the [new Azure SDK guidelines](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/general_introduction.html), and provides many core capabilities:

    - Support MSAL.NET, Azure.Identity is out of box for supporting MSAL.NET.
    - Support [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/) for distributed tracing.
    - HTTP pipeline with custom policies.
    - Better error-handling.
    - Support uniform telemetry across all languages.

## Getting started 

### Install the package

Install the Microsoft Azure Private Dns management library for .NET with [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/):

```dotnetcli
dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.PrivateDns
```

### Prerequisites

* You must have an [Microsoft Azure subscription](https://azure.microsoft.com/free/dotnet/).

### Authenticate the Client

To create an authenticated client and start interacting with Microsoft Azure resources, see the [quickstart guide here](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).

## Key concepts

Key concepts of the Microsoft Azure SDK for .NET can be found [here](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/dotnet_introduction.html).

## Documentation

Documentation is available to help you learn how to use this package:

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).
- [API References](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/?view=azure-dotnet).
- [Authentication](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/sdk/identity/Azure.Identity/README.md).

## Examples

Code samples for using the management library for .NET can be found in the following locations
- [.NET Management Library Code Samples](https://aka.ms/azuresdk-net-mgmt-samples)

## Troubleshooting

-   File an issue via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/issues).
-   Check [previous questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/azure+.net) or ask new ones on Stack Overflow using Azure and .NET tags.

## Next steps

For more information about Microsoft Azure SDK, see [this website](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/).

## Contributing

For details on contributing to this repository, see the [contributing
guide][cg].

This project welcomes contributions and suggestions. Most contributions
require you to agree to a Contributor License Agreement (CLA) declaring
that you have the right to, and actually do, grant us the rights to use
your contribution. For details, visit <https://cla.microsoft.com>.

When you submit a pull request, a CLA-bot will automatically determine
whether you need to provide a CLA and decorate the PR appropriately
(for example, label, comment). Follow the instructions provided by the
bot. You'll only need to do this action once across all repositories
using our CLA.

This project has adopted the [Microsoft Open Source Code of Conduct][coc]. For
more information, see the [Code of Conduct FAQ][coc_faq] or contact
<opencode@microsoft.com> with any other questions or comments.

proposals.subtype: Aggregate record-data factory signature suppression metadata
proposals.explanation: The factory partial targets PrivateDnsRecordData(ResourceIdentifier,string,ResourceType,SystemData,PrivateDnsRecordSetProperties,ETag?) with CodeGenSuppressAttribute. No implementation of that signature is captured.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: An active signature-specific Custom attribute is explicit metadata, not proof of the uncaptured generated factory or the comment's internal-type diagnosis.

proposals.subtype: String-network virtual-link factory signature suppression metadata
proposals.explanation: The partial targets a VirtualNetworkLinkData factory signature with tags/location, nullable registration/resolution/state/provisioning parameters, a string and a final nullable ETag; neither that method body nor the string parameter's name is supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full ordered typeof list is captured in active Custom suppression metadata; the attribute alone does not establish a replacement body or generated API outcome.

proposals.subtype: WritableSubResource virtual-link factory signature suppression metadata
proposals.explanation: A distinct CodeGenSuppressAttribute targets the VirtualNetworkLinkData factory shape containing WritableSubResource after AzureLocation and ETag? at the end, alongside nullable registration/resolution/state/provisioning inputs.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This is active signature-specific Custom metadata with no matching implementation captured; it is distinct from the two ResourceIdentifier-taking factory bodies.

proposals.subtype: Hidden twelve-argument virtual-link factory adapting a resource identifier
proposals.explanation: The optional twelve-argument overload has matching suppression metadata and EditorBrowsable(Never). It normalizes null tags, wraps a nonnull virtualNetworkId in WritableSubResource, and creates VirtualNetworkLinkProperties only when at least one of its five supplied inputs is nonnull, carrying the nullable resolution policy through.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual Custom static factory constructs nested models directly; its matching suppression is grouped with that same implemented signature rather than double-counted.

proposals.subtype: Hidden eleven-argument virtual-link factory defaulting resolution policy
proposals.explanation: The distinct eleven-argument overload has matching suppression metadata and EditorBrowsable(Never). It normalizes tags, conditionally wraps virtualNetworkId and creates a nested properties object when one of four supplied properties is nonnull, passing default in the resolution-policy position.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The complete Custom body constructs the data model rather than forwarding to the other overload; the matching suppression is one cohesive finding with this body.

proposals.subtype: Hidden AAAA create/update overloads assembling match conditions
proposals.explanation: The hidden sync and async overloads turn separate ETag? ifMatch and string ifNoneMatch inputs into MatchConditions, converting nonnull ifNoneMatch strings to ETag and otherwise using default(ETag?). They forward the same WaitUntil, name, data and token; the async call uses ConfigureAwait(false).
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual Custom bodies implement parameter adaptation, not a custom LRO poller, retry policy or independently inspected HTTP-header implementation.

proposals.subtype: AAAA-bound pageable list wrappers with typed resource projection
proposals.explanation: GetAll/GetAllAsync call the corresponding shared PrivateDnsRecordData helper with the literal record type AAAA, supplied top/suffix/token, a diagnostic operation name, and a projection that calls ToAaaaRecordData before constructing PrivateDnsAaaaRecordResource.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom wrappers specialize list scope and result construction. The shared helper is not captured, so no next-link algorithm, page-size transformation or network behavior is inferred.

proposals.explanation: Generic and nongeneric IEnumerable.GetEnumerator implementations delegate to GetAll().GetEnumerator(). The IAsyncEnumerable implementation passes its token both to GetAllAsync and the returned pageable's GetAsyncEnumerator.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Three concrete Custom interface implementations enable iteration over the collection itself; they are grouped separately from the list helper's fixed-type specialization.

proposals.subtype: AAAA list getter lazily creating the properties envelope
proposals.explanation: PrivateDnsAaaaRecords checks whether Properties is null, assigns a new PrivateDnsRecordSetProperties when necessary, and returns Properties.PrivateDnsAaaaRecords directly. The captured getter does not itself construct or copy a list.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A complete Custom getter exposes the nested typed list with lazy envelope initialization; no generated counterpart or base-model behavior is assumed.

proposals.subtype: Typed AAAA JSON reader with response, request and persistence bridges
proposals.explanation: The Custom typed deserializer handles JSON null, reads id/name/type/systemData/properties/etag, and stores unknown fields as raw BinaryData only outside format W. FromResponse uses WireOptions; ToRequestContent is null-preserving and also uses WireOptions. JSON Write delegates to JsonModelWriteCore between object delimiters, JSON/persistable Create parse then call this deserializer, persistable Write uses the context, and GetFormatFromOptions returns J.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The complete Custom typed reader and interface bridge bodies are captured outside Generated. Related read/write entry points form one codec finding; the delegated core writer and nested properties parser are not supplied.

proposals.subtype: AAAA resource bound to its per-record data type
proposals.explanation: The otherwise empty PrivateDnsAaaaRecordResource partial has an active CodeGenResourceDataAttribute selecting PrivateDnsAaaaRecordData.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The nonempty customization signal is explicit generation metadata, not the empty resource-class body or a claimed generated resource implementation.

proposals.explanation: The hidden sync and async overloads assemble MatchConditions from separate ETag? ifMatch and string ifNoneMatch arguments, converting each nonnull ifNoneMatch to ETag and using default(ETag?) for null. They forward WaitUntil, name, data and token; async uses ConfigureAwait(false).
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Complete Custom forwarding bodies implement conditional-parameter adaptation; the presence of WaitUntil/ArmOperation does not establish handwritten polling.

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom pageable wrappers fix the record type and project results; actual continuation handling remains in an uncaptured helper.

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The three complete Custom interface bodies provide collection iteration, grouped as one behavior distinct from record-type/result specialization in the list methods.

proposals.explanation: PrivateDnsARecords creates a PrivateDnsRecordSetProperties envelope when Properties is null and returns the nested PrivateDnsARecords list directly; no list construction or defensive copy is present in this getter.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual Custom getter implements lazy nested-property exposure. Whether the nested list is initialized depends on an uncaptured type.

decisions.reason: The handwritten factory partial explicitly directs suppression of this exact aggregate-record factory signature. This counts the directive, not an independently observed generated method or its removal; the explanatory comment does not establish a generator defect.

The captured directive separately targets the WritableSubResource-taking signature. No generated counterpart or replacement implementation is asserted, and the later ResourceIdentifier overloads have different signatures.

The full twelve-parameter handwritten factory and matching suppression are captured; its nested model construction, null handling and resolution-policy forwarding are stated accurately. Generator-addressable is a plausible opportunity, not verified support.

This eleven-parameter overload has its own body and exact suppression signature; its default resolution-policy argument and four-way null guard are visible. It is not a duplicate of the twelve-parameter overload.

The forwarding and MatchConditions construction are demonstrated, but the original legacy-overload-compatibility pattern asserts an unverified historical or compatibility motive. Use a reusable behavior-based pattern instead.

decisions.reason: Both A-bound list wrappers visibly fix the record type to A and map data through ToARecordData to typed resources. The unseen common helper's continuation behavior is deliberately not inferred.
